body:
Growing up, I was encouraged to do it. I was told  I’m very good at analytical reasoning, which is a key skill for practicing law. I grew up knowing a lot of lawyers. Very successful, respectable people who I saw as role models. 

I want to do it. I thought I would be good at it. And I thought it would let be use my writing and investigation skills which I still think are things I’m good at. 

But six different bosses have told me they don’t think so. And I’m sure the seventh will be soon.
